scope: Full report for the existing five paired CE runs; no training or evaluation protocol changes
timing: Exploratory analysis specification recorded after seeds 0 and 1 final results were available
primary_unit: Paired seed, not 640 independent example-seed observations
groups: all five seeds including historical seed zero
summary: 95% Student-t interval for mean paired gap
sample variance and SD of each condition
uncertainty: Seed-t intervals assume approximately independent normally distributed seed differences; small-n, adaptive benchmark caveats mandatory. No variance significance test. Per-seed paired-example bootstrap intervals are descriptive and do not replace seed replication.
curves: Shared 32-case validation set, exact accuracy and response CE at 64,128,256,512,768,1024; trapezoidal normalized area over updates 64-1024
graph_features: mean minimum input-population-to-output distance among reachable outputs
fraction of output population reachable from any input neuron
graph_correlation: Only after all five rewired outcomes finish: descriptive Pearson and Spearman correlations, no causal attribution, fitted predictive model or p-value-based selection. Constant features undefined. Rewiring seed, weight initialization seed and sampling seed co-vary, so graph versus optimization effects are not identified.
report_status: Interim until all five matched final evaluations and artifact audits complete; compiler-method tournament reported separately as pending/in progress
